reason: This refactor concentrates on MPP executor error recovery/retry flow across core runtime paths (`executor_with_retry`, coordinator, recovery handler, `mpp_gather`) and also touches `distsql`. Even without obvious SQL-semantic changes in the title, retry/recovery logic in distributed execution is high-risk for executor correctness: duplicate or missing result delivery, incorrect retry boundaries, cancellation/timeout handling, and inconsistent error propagation are all plausible High-severity failure modes. The change is small in file count but central in behavior and not a routine local tweak.
